title: Active packaging film based on a green composite: fabrication and performance analysis of pineapple leaf fiber-reinforced PBAT
content:

For high-value utilization of pineapple leaf waste, pineapple leaf fiber ultrafine powder (PLFUP) was prepared by oscillatory ultrafine grinding, then blended with PBAT and blow-molded into composite films.
